badges.label: A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt
Launches programs on your computer
badges.detail: Programs it names include codesign, ditto, open, spctl, sw_vers and 1 more

badges.label: Works with files on your computer
Runs its own server for programs on this computer
Other programs on this computer can change your library through it

reasons: Its code names developers' servers: api.beaverapp.ai, beaverapp.ai and www.beaverapp.ai
A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you (from zotero-plugin-toolkit)
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt (from zotero-plugin-toolkit)
